points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build succeeds with supplied dependencies in network-disabled container; compiler warns about misleading indentation and unused code; CTest has no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:824–836 parses solve, case/output, restart and report-level; :694–734 restart loads current state. It omits physical time and previous BDF state.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Main solver/mesh/numerics are concentrated in main.cpp; reporting is in a separate script.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper found; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON configuration and CGNS path determine cases and mesh; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:842–858 root preprocessing mesh is released before solve; METIS owned/ghost and neighbour exchange present. Historical np1/8 force pairs close.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Admissible-state backtracking and finite/mesh checks exist; MPI_Abort handles exceptions. No independent memory stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean immutable-source build succeeds; CTest finds no registered tests. Prior official validator is structural and does not establish physics.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report assets are retained; raw outputs and manifests reside in original attempt297126a, not curated tip.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
